title: 86 Lorcan Grove, Dublin 9, Santry, Dublin 9, D09K2N4
seoTitle: 86 Lorcan Grove, Dublin 9, Santry, Dublin 9, D09K2N4
description:
Smith & Butler Estates are delighted to present this charming and spacious five-bedroom, three-bathroom semi-detached home with a side garage, ideally situated on the well-established Lorcan Grove. Offering generous accommodation and excellent potential to create a wonderful family home, the property also qualifies for the Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant, subject to the relevant terms and approval. This is a fantastic opportunity for buyers looking to refurbish and personalise a substantial property in a mature and popular residential location.

Upon entering the property, a bright, welcoming hallway with timber flooring and a period-style staircase sets the tone for the home. The ground floor offers excellent living space, comprising a front reception room with a feature fireplace and bay window, flowing into a bright open dining area with French doors leading out to the rear garden. A separate kitchen, fitted with light timber cabinetry, granite-style countertops and space for laundry appliances, overlooks the rear garden, while a guest bathroom, fitted out with accessibility rails and a step-in shower, and an integral garage complete this level.

The first floor comprises five extremely well-proportioned bedrooms, including a primary bedroom with fitted mirrored wardrobes and a private ensuite shower room, offering a bright and comfortable retreat with pleasant outlooks over the surrounding area. There are three further generously sized double bedrooms, each fitted with built-in wardrobes providing excellent storage, along with a single box-style bedroom, also benefiting from fitted wardrobe space, perfect as a child's room, nursery, or home office. A charming and well-appointed family bathroom, fitted with a bath and neutral tiling, serves the remaining bedrooms on this level, completing a floor that offers exceptional flexibility for a growing family. A separate attic room completes the interior accommodation. Accessed by a charming spiral staircase, this room provides valuable extra storage or hobby space, with Velux-style window and carpeted flooring.

Externally, the property benefits from a rear garden with a large timber deck, ideal for outdoor relaxing, dining and entertaining, leading onto a generously sized lawned area enclosed by part-block, part-hedge boundaries for privacy. To the front, a large driveway provides off-street parking with access to the garage from the front, providing excellent storage or parking space.

Lorcan Grove is a mature and highly convenient residential location, close to a range of local amenities including schools, shops, cafés, Beaumont Hospital and parks such as Ellenfield park. The area benefits from excellent transport links, with nearby bus routes and easy access to the M1, M50, Dublin Airport, and Dublin City Centre, making it an ideal location for families, first-time buyers, and investors alike.

This is a superb opportunity for buyers seeking generous living space across multiple levels, in a convenient, established location.

Foyer – 1.92 m x 5.27 m – A welcoming entrance hall leading leading to the living room and dining/family room. Featuring warm wood flooring, decorative crystal pendant lighting, and a carpeted staircase leading to the upper floors.

Living Room – 3.97 m x 5.88 m – A bright and spacious open reception room with semi-solid wood flooring, an elegant feature fireplace, coved ceiling, pendant lighting, and a large bay window flooding the room with natural light.

Family Room – 3.49 m x 3.20 m – A bright, open reception room with semi-solid wood flooring, coved ceiling, pendant lighting and rear garden access via French double doors. Excellent for relaxing and entertaining alike.

Dining Area – 2.37 m x 3.20 m – A bright, open dining space with semi-solid wood flooring, coved ceiling, pendant lighting and a window overlooking the rear garden flooding the room with natural light. Excellent space for dining, relaxing and entertaining.

Kitchen – 2.83 m x 3.01 m – A warm and bright fitted kitchen with warm wood-toned cabinetry providing excellent storage space, checkerboard tile splash-back, granite countertops, integrated extractor fan, wood-effect flooring, and a large window overlooking the garden and flooding the kitchen with natural light.

Bath (Ground Floor WC) – 1.38 m x 2.22 m – An accessible ground-floor bathroom finished in neutral floor to ceiling tiling, fitted with grab rails, a walk-in shower area, under sink storage and wall mounted mirror.

Hall (2nd/3rd Floor) – A carpeted landing leading to all five bedrooms and the family bathroom with a wooden spiral staircase leading up to the third-floor room.

Primary Bedroom – 2.85 m x 4.15 m – A generously sized main bedroom to the front of the property. Featuring a walk-in shower and sink with tiled splashback, fitted mirrored sliding wardrobes, carpeted flooring, pendant ceiling lighting, and a large window with curtain rail flooding the room with natural light.

Bedroom – 2.85 m x 5.04 m – A generous double bedroom with wood flooring, a pendant ceiling light, fitted wardrobes offering excellent storage space, with an integrated sink, and a window with views over the rear garden.

Bedroom – 2.31 m x 3.09 m – A compact box-style bedroom to the front of the property. Featuring a pendant ceiling light, carpeted flooring and excellent built in wardrobe space with an integrated vanity table.

Bedroom – 3.44 m x 4.10 m – A well-proportioned bedroom to the front of the property. Featuring fitted built-in wardrobes and built in vanity table, carpeted flooring, and a front-facing window dressed with a curtain rail flooding the room with natural light.

Bedroom – 3.89 m x 2.79 m – A comfortable double bedroom to the rear of the property. Featuring built in wardrobes with a fitted vanity table, carpeted flooring, vaulted ceiling detailing, a pendant light fitting, and a window with curtain rail flooding the room with natural light.

Bathroom – 1.86 m x 1.74 m – A generously sized family bathroom finished in classic blue tiling and splashback, with a panelled bath, pedestal basin, frosted window, wall mounted mirror and wood flooring.

Converted attic – 5.54 m x 3.10 m – A versatile converted attic-level room with sloped ceilings, patterned carpet flooring, a Velux skylight window, and built-in storage to the side. A spacious room providing convenient extra storage and living space.

Garage – 2.91 m x 6.20 m – An integrated garage accessible from inside and the front of the property, providing excellent storage and parking space, and potential for conversion.

Total – 142 m² / 1,528 ft²

Exterior – To the front, the property presents as a semi-detached home with a red brick facade, tiled roof, and twin chimneys with satellite dishes. A block-paved driveway leads to an integral garage, with a low boundary wall and wrought-iron railings enclosing a small front garden. To the rear, the garden features a raised timber decking area accessed directly from the house, opening onto a lawned section bordered by block walls and hedging. A paved patio area near the rear boundary provides additional outdoor space, excellent space for outdoor dining, relaxing and entertaining.
